remarks: Coming soon - Prime in-town living at the Town & Country showcases a stunning 6th floor penthouse apartment ideally located in the heart of Greenwich, just one block from the exceptional shops and restaurants on Greenwich Avenue, the Y and Whole Foods. Enjoy all of the premium amenities this elegant, newly renovated building has to offer with 24 hour concierge doorman, stylish lobby, in-house super, designated storage and adjoining garage.
